get.description: Retrieves statistical data related to help articles in the knowledge base.

parameters.name: rootCategoryIds
parameters.description: ID(s) of the knowledge base root categories to consider

parameters.name: statsType
parameters.description: Type of statistical data to fetch. Possible values: ARTICLES_REFERENCED, VOTED_PORTAL_USERS, CREATED_ARTICLES, MODIFIED_ARTICLE

parameters.name: departmentIds
parameters.description: ID(s) of the departments to consider

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language to filter by

parameters.name: timeRange
parameters.description: Period to filter by. Possible values: LAST_24_HRS, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_30_DAYS, LAST_365_DAYS, and yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ,yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ

get.description: Retrieves overall trend data for user actions recorded across the entire knowledge base.

parameters.name: rootCategoryIds
parameters.description: ID(s) of the knowledge base root categories to consider

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of trend-related records to list. The default value is 1000 and the maximum value allowed is 18000.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: User action whose trend-related records must be fetched. Values allowed are: !@LIKE,@! !@DISLIKE,@! !@VIEW,@! !@TICKET_USAGE,@! !@COMMENT,@! !@TEMPLATE_USAGE@! and !@FEEDBACK@!. If you do not pass a value, all actions are included.

parameters.name: permission
parameters.description: User visibility permission . Possible Values: !@ALL,@! !@REGISTEREDUSERS@! and !@AGENTS@!.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the trend-related records must be fetched. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: departmentIds
parameters.description: ID(s) of the departments to consider

parameters.name: userType
parameters.description: Type of users. Values allowed are: AGENTS, REGISTERED_USERS, PUBLIC_USERS, END_USERS and ALL_USERS (default).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language to filter by

parameters.name: helpcenterIds
parameters.description: ID(s) of help centers to consider

parameters.name: timeRange
parameters.description: Period to filter by. Possible values: LAST_24_HRS, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_30_DAYS, LAST_365_DAYS, and yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ,yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ

parameters.name: actionSource
parameters.description: Channel in which the action was performed. Possible values: !@API,@! !@HELPCENTER,@! !@ASAP_WEB,@! !@ASAP_ANDROID,@! !@ASAP_IOS@! and !@AGENT_VIEW@!. If you do not pass a value, all sources are included.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Publishing status of the translation. Values allowed are: Draft, Published, Review, Expired and Unpublished.
